item.title: About
item.description:
Hello! You can call me Alex :D

I’m Alexsandro, but everyone calls me Alex. Data Coordinator and Tech Lead at ImpulsoGov, where I handle the Data Warehouse architecture, the data pipelines and the cloud infrastructure behind public health work.

Other technical interests: software architecture, event-driven systems, Rust, 3D printing and vintage hardware (mainly Game Boy Advance).

Teacher

I’ve been teaching for years, from basic programming to data engineering. If you run a tech education project and could use a hand, reach out on LinkedIn.
